title: Rezoning for Sojourner Truth-Mapes site, Bronx
summary: This application would amend the zoning map in Bronx Community District 6 by removing a commercial overlay, changing an R7-1 district to R8, and establishing a new commercial overlay within the proposed R8 district. The change affects the Sojourner Truth-Mapes site near Crotona Parkway. It is submitted by 2136 Crotona Parkway Housing Development Fund Corporation.
